_comment: What a perk does, in OUR OWN WORDS. Hand-authored, never generated.
The game states each perk's effect as a written sentence, and that sentence
is in-game prose — hard rule 1 applies absolutely, so it is never copied and
never lightly reworded. Each entry here is a mechanical restatement of the
effect as a fact, written from scratch after reading the mechanism in the
game files (perks.toml gates cross-checked against artifacts.toml pools,
fish.toml perk_artifact fields, and locations.toml dig site counts).
Only perks that gate WHERE OR WHETHER something can be found belong here —
the ones a 'needs the X perk' pill can leave a player asking 'and what does
that do?'. Stat boosts and quality-of-life perks stay out; describing all
137 would be a wiki, and this project is not one.

effects.well_placed: makes overworld dig sites occasionally yield out-of-place artifacts
effects.mist_sight: makes a mist spot appear around Mistria each day, dug for essence
effects.former_farmers: adds a daily dig site on your own farm with its own artifact set
effects.stoneturner: makes rocks in the mines sometimes drop artifacts when broken
effects.sunken_secrets: lets dive spots contain sunken artifacts
effects.aquatic_antiquities: lets aquatic artifacts turn up while fishing
effects.western_ruins_scholar: adds a second daily dig site at the Western Ruins
effects.eastern_road_scholar: adds a second daily dig site on the Eastern Road
effects.legendary: lets legendary fish appear when season and weather are right
effects.abyssal_ascendence: lets an abyssal chest be fished up
